title: Tongue Twisters (쌘문장)
description: High-difficulty Korean typing challenge sentences and classic tongue twisters

items.target: 경찰청 창살은 외창살인가 쌍창살인가.
items.translation: Are the window bars of the police station single bars or double bars?

items.target: 내가 그린 기린 그림은 목이 긴 기린 그림이고, 네가 그린 기린 그림은 목 안 긴 기린 그림이다.
items.translation: The giraffe picture I drew is a long-necked giraffe picture, and the giraffe picture you drew is a giraffe picture whose neck is not long.

items.target: 간장 공장 공장장은 강 공장장이고, 된장 공장 공장장은 공 공장장이다.
items.translation: The factory manager of the soy sauce factory is Factory Manager Kang, and the factory manager of the soybean paste factory is Factory Manager Kong.

items.target: 들콩깍지는 깐 콩깍지인가 안 깐 콩깍지인가.
items.translation: Is the wild bean pod a shelled bean pod or an unshelled bean pod?

items.target: 안흥 찐빵집 찐빵은 뜨거운 찐빵이고, 양평 찐빵집 찐빵은 차가운 찐빵이다.
items.translation: The steamed bun at the Anheung steamed bun shop is a hot steamed bun, and the steamed bun at the Yangpyeong steamed bun shop is a cold steamed bun.

items.target: 서울특별시 특허허가과 허가과장 허과장.
items.translation: Section Chief Heo, the Permit Section Chief of the Seoul Metropolitan Patent Authorization Department.

items.target: 중앙청 창살은 쌍창살이고 구청 창살은 외창살이다.
items.translation: The Capitol Building window bars are double bars, and the district office window bars are single bars.

items.target: 저기 있는 저 분은 상표 붙인 통조림을 산 분인가, 상표 안 붙인 통조림을 산 분인가.
items.translation: Is that person over there someone who bought a labeled canned good, or someone who bought an unlabeled canned good?

items.target: 칠월 칠일은 평창군 평창읍 찰옥수수 수확날이다.
items.translation: July 7th is the waxy corn harvest day in Pyeongchang-eup, Pyeongchang County.

items.target: 저기 계신 저 분이 바로 우리 구의 새 대건축가이시다.
items.translation: That person standing over there is none other than our district's new master architect.

items.target: 한양 양장점 옆 한영 양장점, 한영 양장점 옆 한양 양장점.
items.translation: Hanyoung Boutique next to Hanyang Boutique, Hanyang Boutique next to Hanyoung Boutique.

items.target: 뼛조각이 굵은 닭은 닭장에 있고, 뼛조각이 가는 닭은 흙 속에 있다.
items.translation: The chicken with thick bones is in the chicken coop, and the chicken with thin bones is in the soil.

items.target: 제주도 서귀포시 감귤 농장의 붉은 감귤은 단 감귤이다.
items.translation: The reddish tangerines from the citrus farm in Seogwipo, Jeju Island are sweet tangerines.

items.target: 멍멍이네 꿀돈은 꿀 꿀돈이고 꿀돈이네 멍멍이는 멍 멍멍이다.
items.translation: Doggy's piggy goes oink-oink, and Piggy's doggy goes woof-woof.

items.target: 신진 샴푸의 샴푸 용기는 핑크색 샴푸 용기이다.
items.translation: The shampoo bottle for Shinjin Shampoo is a pink shampoo bottle.

items.target: 경찰청 쇠창살은 외철창살이고 검찰청 쇠창살은 쌍철창살이다.
items.translation: The police agency iron bars are single iron bars, and the prosecutor's office iron bars are double iron bars.

items.target: 저기 저 뜀틀이 내가 뛸 뜀틀인가 내가 안 뛸 뜀틀인가.
items.translation: Is that vaulting horse over there the vaulting horse I will vault over, or the vaulting horse I will not vault over?

items.target: 신진 샹송가수의 신춘 샹송쇼.
items.translation: Rising chanson singer's new spring chanson show.

items.target: 상표 붙인 큰 깡통은 깐 깡통인가 안 깐 깡통인가.
items.translation: Is the large labeled tin can an opened can or an unopened can?

items.target: 고려고 교복은 고급 교복이고 고려고 교복은 고급 원단을 사용했다.
items.translation: Goryeo High School uniforms are premium uniforms, and Goryeo High School uniforms use premium fabric.

items.target: 작년에 온 솥장수는 새 솥장수이고, 금년에 온 솥장수는 헌 솥장수이다.
items.translation: The cauldron seller who came last year is a new cauldron seller, and the cauldron seller who came this year is an old cauldron seller.

items.target: 도토리가 문을 도로록, 드르륵, 두루룩 열었는가.
items.translation: Did the acorn open the door with a rolling, rattling, sliding sound?

items.target: 앞집 팥죽은 붉은 팥 풋팥죽이고, 뒷집 콩죽은 햇콩 단콩 콩죽이다.
items.translation: The front house's red bean porridge is fresh red bean porridge, and the back house's soybean porridge is sweet new-harvest bean porridge.

items.target: 박 법학 박사님은 백 법학 박사님보다 법학을 더 잘 아신다.
items.translation: Dr. Park, Doctor of Law, knows jurisprudence better than Dr. Baek, Doctor of Law.

items.target: 시골 찹쌀 햇찹쌀, 도시 햇찹쌀 시골 찹쌀, 햇찹쌀 찰찹쌀.
items.translation: Rural glutinous rice, newly harvested glutinous rice; city fresh glutinous rice, rural glutinous rice; newly harvested sticky glutinous rice.

items.target: 내가 그린 구름그림은 새털구름 그린 구름그림이고, 네가 그린 구름그림은 깃털구름 그린 구름그림이다.
items.translation: The cloud picture I drew is a cirrus cloud cloud-picture, and the cloud picture you drew is a feather-cloud cloud-picture.

items.target: 저기 가는 저 상장사가 새 상 상장사냐 헌 상 상장사냐.
items.translation: Is that table merchant walking over there a merchant selling new tables, or a merchant selling used tables? (상 = small dining table)

items.target: 양양역 앞 양장점은 양양 양장점이고, 영양역 앞 영화관은 영양 영화관이다.
items.translation: The boutique in front of Yangyang Station is Yangyang Boutique, and the cinema in front of Yeongyang Station is Yeongyang Cinema.

items.target: 작은 토끼 토끼통 옆에는 큰 토끼 토끼통이 있고, 큰 토끼 토끼통 옆에는 작은 토끼 토끼통이 있다.
items.translation: Next to the small rabbit's cage is a big rabbit's cage, and next to the big rabbit's cage is a small rabbit's cage.

items.target: 한국관광공사 곽진광 관광과장.
items.translation: Tourism Section Chief Kwak Jin-gwang of the Korea Tourism Organization.

items.target: 백합 백화점 옆 백화 백화점, 백화 백화점 옆 백합 백화점.
items.translation: Baekhwa Department Store next to Baekhap Department Store, Baekhap Department Store next to Baekhwa Department Store.

items.target: 생각이란 생각하면 생각할수록 생각나는 것이 생각이므로, 생각하지 않는 생각이 좋은 생각이라 생각한다.
items.translation: Since a thought is something that comes to mind the more you think about it, I think the thought of not thinking is a good thought.

items.target: 체다치즈를 최고 많이 먹은 최다은이 체다치즈 먹기 대회 최다 우승자이다.
items.translation: Choi Da-eun, who ate the most cheddar cheese, is the all-time record winner of the cheddar cheese eating contest.

items.target: 이수지가 저수지에 갔는데, 이 수지가 저수지에 간 걸까 저 수지가 저수지에 간 걸까 고민했다.
items.translation: Lee Su-ji went to a reservoir, and wondered whether this Su-ji went to the reservoir or that Su-ji went to the reservoir.

items.target: 칠월 칠일은 평창 친구 친정 칠순 잔칫날이다.
items.translation: July 7th is the 70th birthday celebration day for my Pyeongchang friend's mother.

items.target: 우리집 깨죽은 검은깨 깨죽인데 사람들은 햇콩 단콩 콩죽 깨죽 먹기를 싫어하더라.
items.translation: Our house's sesame porridge is black sesame porridge, but people disliked eating the sweet new-harvest bean porridge and sesame porridge.

items.target: 뽕나무 숲의 뽕나무는 뽕뽕 방귀 뀐 뽕나무인가 뽕뽕뽕 방귀 뀐 뽕나무인가.
items.translation: Is the mulberry tree in the mulberry forest a tree that farted 'bbong-bbong' or a tree that farted 'bbong-bbong-bbong'?

items.target: 그 집 콩밭은 검정 콩밭이고 내 집 콩밭은 강낭콩밭이며 검정 콩밭 옆에 강낭콩밭이 있다.
items.translation: That house's bean field is a black bean field, my house's bean field is a kidney bean field, and next to the black bean field is a kidney bean field.

items.target: 우유 성분 함유율은 칼슘 함유량이 철분 함유량보다 높은가.
items.translation: In the milk composition ratio, is the calcium content higher than the iron content?

items.target: 앞집 꽃집은 장미꽃 꽃집이고 옆집 꽃꽂이집은 튤립꽃 꽃꽂이집이다.
items.translation: The flower shop in front is a rose flower shop, and the flower arrangement shop next door is a tulip flower arrangement shop.

items.target: 정희수가 희희낙락하게 희끄무리한 흰머리를 뽑으며 웃었다.
items.translation: Jung Hee-soo laughed joyfully with delight while plucking out grayish-white hairs.

items.target: 철수 책상 새 책상, 철수 책장 헌 책장.
items.translation: Cheolsu's desk is a new desk, and Cheolsu's bookcase is an old bookcase.

items.target: 칠수 책상 새 책상, 칠수 책장 헌 책장.
items.translation: Chilsu's desk is a new desk, and Chilsu's bookcase is an old bookcase.

items.target: 김서방네 지붕 위에 콩깍지가 깐 콩깍지냐 안 깐 콩깍지냐.
items.translation: Is the bean pod on Mr. Kim's roof a shelled bean pod or an unshelled bean pod?

items.target: 우리집 옆집 앞집 뒷창살은 홑겹창살이고, 우리집 뒷집 앞집 옆창살은 겹홑창살이다.
items.translation: The rear window bar of the house in front of our neighbor's house is a single bar, and the side window bar of the house in front of our rear neighbor's house is a double bar.

items.target: 저기 있는 말뚝이 말 맬 말뚝이냐 말 못 맬 말뚝이냐.
items.translation: Is that stake over there a stake for hitching a horse or a stake you cannot hitch a horse to?

items.target: 안촉촉한 초코칩 나라에 살던 안촉촉한 초코칩이 촉촉한 초코칩 나라의 촉촉한 초코칩을 보고 촉촉한 초코칩이 되고 싶었다.
items.translation: A non-moist chocochip who lived in Non-Moist Chocochip Land saw a moist chocochip from Moist Chocochip Land and wanted to become a moist chocochip.

items.target: 목동 로얄 뉴로얄 레스토랑 뉴메뉴 미트소시지소스 스파게티.
items.translation: Mokdong Royal New Royal Restaurant's new menu item: meat sausage sauce spaghetti.

items.target: 가랑가랑 가랑비 오면 개구리가 개굴개굴 노래를 한다.
items.translation: When fine drizzle falls softly, frogs sing 'ribbit ribbit'.

items.target: 알콩달콩 깨끗한 콩은 안 깐 콩이고 깐깐한 알콩달콩은 깐 콩이다.
items.translation: The sweet and clean beans are unshelled beans, and the fussy sweet beans are shelled beans.
